name: text-animation
title: Text Animation
description: Five text effects in one component: words rising on a soft spring, a looping shimmer for "Thinking…" states, letters rolling between values, a glyph scramble and a typewriter with a caret. Everything staggers letter by letter on the native driver, and screen readers still hear one clean string.
summary: Reveal, shimmer, cascade, scramble and typewriter text effects.
usage:
import { AnimatedText } from '@/components/ui/text-animation';

<AnimatedText textStyle={{ fontSize: 28, fontWeight: '600' }}>
  Ship native apps that feel alive.
</AnimatedText>

<AnimatedText variant="shimmer">Thinking…</AnimatedText>
<AnimatedText variant="cascade">{status}</AnimatedText>
behavior: Reveal, shimmer and cascade run one native-driver clock per animation with spring curves pre-sampled into interpolations; scramble and typewriter use a light JS timer. Text wraps by word.
Shows the final text immediately; shimmer stays static and the typewriter caret is hidden.
The whole string is one text element; the per-letter views are hidden. Cascade and typewriter announce new text when it changes (typewriter once streaming settles).
iOS, Android and web. Arabic, Hebrew, Indic, Thai and other connected scripts animate a word at a time so shaping is never broken; right-to-left text flows from the right.
props: Animate once on mount, or also every time the text changes. A typewriter keeps typing when the new text extends the old (streaming).
ms between words (reveal) or letters. Shimmer: ms of sweep per letter.
Speed multiplier: 2 plays twice as fast.
Change it to replay the animation.
Called when an animation finishes (not for the looping shimmer).
fontSize, fontWeight, lineHeight, letterSpacing, textAlign… for every letter.
